findings.text: The company was incorporated on 27 October 1987 and its status is recorded as dissolved, with cessation on 22 December 2025.
One insolvency case is on record: a members' voluntary liquidation, with the company wound up on 20 May 2025 and dissolved on 22 December 2025.
The accounts are recorded with unknown overdue status and no next due date, with the last accounts made up to 31 December 2023.
The confirmation statement is recorded with unknown overdue status and no next due date, with the last statement made up to 5 March 2025.
One current person with significant control is recorded: CORPORATE CONTROLLER 1141, holding ownership of shares between 75 and 100 percent.
The company has 2 current officers: one director, A. SMITH CANARY-A22, appointed 11 May 2022, and one other officer.
The current director is linked to 11 other companies, of which 8 are active, 2 dissolved and 1 in liquidation; the matching may be incomplete because appointments are matched by officer ID.
No charges are registered against the company, and no registered office address changes or officer appointments or resignations were filed since 24 October 2025.
